title: Embedded onboarding artifacts and legal checklist for air-gapped KMS + RBAC private deployments
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Objective: Produce a single, embeddable onboarding kit for enterprise customers adopting air-gapped private deployments that require KMS integration and RBAC + audit logging. The kit should include: concise release notes tailored for legal/compliance reviewers, a pre-flight checklist for operator teams (network, storage, KMS keys), sample RBAC role manifests, audit-log retention guidance, a short runbook for emergency key rotation, and templated customer communication language for staged activation.

Scope: This ticket covers curation and coordination only (collateral + legal checklist + release notes snippets + localization brief). Implementation tasks (runtime changes, installers) live in ENG dependencies. Deliverables: 1) One-page "Operator Quickstart" PDF optimized for SRE/Platform teams; 2) Release-notes snippets (customer-friendly & legal-friendly variants); 3) Compliance checklist (controls mapping to SOC2/GDPR); 4) Sample RBAC JSON/YAML snippets (least privilege templates) for Common operator roles; 5) KMS preflight and emergency rotation runbook; 6) Email and portal copy for staged activation waves.

Trade-offs and decisions made so far: 1) We will ship minimal, legally-vetted language in the release notes and defer full legal contract updates to the legal team (reason: timelines for customers requesting early access). 2) For air-gapped installs we will recommend a validated KMS pattern (Customer-managed HSM via proxy) instead of building a bespoke connector — reduces engineering scope and compliance surface. 3) RBAC templates will be intentionally conservative (deny-by-default) which may require small operator tweaks; we will provide a "relaxation examples" appendix.

Stakeholders: Legal: Priya Rao (review release language). Security/Compliance: Omar Castillo (controls mapping). Engineering lead: Sangeeta Rao (ENG-9021). Console/Docs: Elena Park (release-note formatting). Sales/CS enablement: Aaron Singh (customer comms + FAQ). Support: Tier2 lead Hannah Li (support runbooks).

Acceptance Criteria: - All deliverables uploaded to Confluence and Drive with clear filenames and tags. - Release-notes snippets approved by Legal and Security. - Operator Quickstart validated with one pilot customer (internal or partner) and feedback captured. - Templates reference exact API/CLI commands and link to ENG PRs.

Risks and mitigations: - Risk: Legal requests significant rewrites close to release; Mitigation: Provide two language tiers (short legal blurb + long appendix) and reserve 24h legal contigency slot. - Risk: RBAC templates too restrictive and block pilot; Mitigation: include relaxation examples and a quick rollback plan in runbook.

Notes about uniqueness: This ticket focuses on "embedded" artifacts meant to travel with the installer, release manifest, and product portal — not just a standalone blog-style release note. That means file size constraints, one-page operator quickstart, and templated copy for embedding into partner launch portals.

Links and references: Confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PD/PM-82456+Airgap+Onboarding (internal). Demo PR (installer payload): https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-installer/pull/274. Pilot customer request: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/CC-1228.
